verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer user-defined event-triggered automation rules, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no rules engine, workflow automation, or event-triggered action configuration. Recurring payment plans are fixed schedules, and payment splitting into subaccounts is a specific payment feature, not general user-defined event rules, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
